# Satelink Network

> Satelink is a DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure) RPC gateway on
> Polygon PoS. Developers and autonomous machines pay a flat $0.00003 USDT per
> blockchain RPC call (prepaid credits, permissionless on-chain deposits);
> node operators earn 50% of the revenue their nodes serve. Machine customers
> can onboard fully autonomously via an HTTP 402 flow. Live status and all
> published metrics are measured, never estimated.

Key facts:
- Metered rate: $0.00003 per call ($30 per million calls), flat, no plans.
- Free tier: 500 calls/day per IP, no account required.
- Chains: Polygon PoS (137), Ethereum (1), Arbitrum (42161), Base (8453), Polygon Amoy (80002).
- Payments: USDT on Polygon PoS to RevenueVault V2 0x577D3716d6Ad5b676d230f5409deF9838FABaCEF (permissionless; ~25 confirmations).
- Revenue split: 50% node operators / 30% platform / 20% distribution pool.
- Machine onboarding: HTTP 402 responses contain the registration endpoint (POST /v1/machine/register), deposit calldata, and working examples.
- SDK: @satelink/sdk on npm (JS/TS). Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 — works with ethers.js, viem, web3.py.
- API base: https://rpc.satelink.network
- Settlement status: epoch accounting live (~10-minute epochs); on-chain broadcast automation in final verification (dry-run) behind explicit safety gates.

- [Developer Guide](https://docs.satelink.network/docs/developer-guide): integration patterns, 402/429 handling, failover
- [Security](https://docs.satelink.network/docs/security): responsible disclosure + security model
